zh: 你不该在当值的时候喝酒！

text:
Listen up, bud.
We do be workin'. *hicks*
zh:
听好了，伙计。
我们这就是在干活。*嗝*

text: We are checkin' the quality of the beverages.
zh: 我们在检查酒水的质量。

text: What do you think of the beverages?
zh: 你觉得这些酒水怎么样？

text: That does not look like quality checking to me.
zh: 我看这可不像是在检查质量。

text: Rair has some of the best beer around.
zh: 莱尔家的啤酒是这一带最棒的。

text: We don't get no drinks anymore in our barracks.
zh: 我们兵营里再也领不到酒喝了。

text: Did you pay your bills already?

Yes.
We even gave a tip.
zh:
结了。
我们还给了小费呢。

text: After all, we are among the noble knights of the royal guard.
zh: 毕竟，我们可是皇家卫队的高贵骑士。

text:
I am a member of the royal guard.
*hicks*
zh:
我是皇家卫队的一员。
*嗝*

text: Now leave if you have nothing more to say, kid.
zh: 没别的话就赶紧走吧，小子。
